fields.name: game work memory
fields.meaning: Live game variables live in the cartridge chip below the save area; not part of the save itself
fields.evidence: packer copies live variables at segment 1000 offsets 0938-4C1E into the save; bytes change on every step

fields.name: copy 0 start marker
fields.meaning: Start marker of the first save copy; always 02, a copy without it counts as empty
fields.evidence: writer d000:7D79 writes it, checker d000:7EC6 returns 1 without it

fields.name: copy 0 length
fields.meaning: Length of the data block that follows: always 0FA7 (4007 bytes)
fields.evidence: packer passes CX=0xFA7; identical in every save

fields.name: game tag
fields.meaning: Fixed tag "ﾃﾞｼﾞｱﾄﾞ02_V0001" copied from the ROM; loading rejects a copy whose tag differs
fields.evidence: packer copies 16 bytes from ROM c55b:000A; loader d000:80B2 compares all 16

fields.name: active tamer
fields.meaning: Which tamer is currently played: 0 = Ryo, 1 = Ken
fields.evidence: packer copies live 0938; used as party/tamer index by step code d000:F254, walker e000:972E, events e000:9E08; 0 in all saves

fields.name: Ryo Digimon party
fields.meaning: 3 Digimon records of 105 bytes for Ryo; first holds Veemon, others empty
fields.evidence: packer copies 0x13B from live 09F6; new-game code uses stride 0x69

fields.name: record: in use
fields.meaning: 1 = slot holds a Digimon, 0 = empty
fields.evidence: party code d000:DFB0 tests it to compact/count; slot 0 = 1, rest 0

fields.name: record: species
fields.meaning: Species number (BE Veemon, C5 Wormmon); also stored at record +0x23
fields.evidence: new-game code sets both bytes; dump matches

fields.name: record: byte 2
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 in every save
fields.evidence: dump only; no code references found

fields.name: record: name
fields.meaning: Digimon name in game kana codes, FF terminated
fields.evidence: new-game code copies 6 bytes from ROM; decodes to Veemon/Wormmon names

fields.name: record: stat pairs 1
fields.meaning: Four 16-bit current/maximum pairs (0120/0120, 0020/0020); first pair behaves like hit points
fields.evidence: dump; identical in both partners; cur/max layout

fields.name: record: stat block 2
fields.meaning: More current/maximum pairs (000E, 14, species-based 32/2D, 0058)
fields.evidence: dump; 0x17/0x18 pair differs by species (32 Veemon, 2D Wormmon)

fields.name: record: byte 1D
fields.meaning: Always FF; set for every slot when a new game starts
fields.evidence: init code e000:74E3 writes FF at each slot

fields.name: record: flags
fields.meaning: Flag word; bit 0x2000 set for the starting partners
fields.evidence: new-game code ORs 0x2000

fields.name: record: byte 20
fields.meaning: Set to 2 for the starting partners
fields.evidence: new-game code writes 2; meaning not identified

fields.name: record: species words
fields.meaning: Two 16-bit values (00BD+00BE Veemon, 0000+00C5 Wormmon); first is likely the previous species
fields.evidence: new-game code writes both words; second mirrors species byte

fields.name: record: bytes 25-66
fields.meaning: Growth data: small values 0-3 then FF fill; likely learned moves or growth flags
fields.evidence: dump only; 6 bytes differ between the two partners

fields.name: record: step counter
fields.meaning: +1 per field step while the Digimon is in the active party, capped at 0x2D0
fields.evidence: step code d000:F254 increments it per slot below the party count; rises 2 -> 27 -> 314 across saves

fields.name: Ken Digimon party
fields.meaning: 3 Digimon records of 105 bytes for Ken; first holds Wormmon, others empty
fields.evidence: packer copies 0x13B from live 0B9A; same stride

fields.evidence: party code tests it; slot 0 = 1, rest 0

fields.name: Ryo party count
fields.meaning: Number of Digimon in Ryo's party (1 in all saves)
fields.evidence: step code uses it as the loop bound; party code counts nonempty slots into it

fields.name: Ken party count
fields.meaning: Number of Digimon in Ken's party (1 in all saves)
fields.evidence: same code, second tamer

fields.name: Ryo species table
fields.meaning: One byte per Digimon species (229); all 0 in saves; a debug switch fills it with 1
fields.evidence: new-game code clears it; debug branch fills it (seen/owned list)

fields.name: Ken species table
fields.meaning: Same 229-byte species table for Ken
fields.evidence: new-game code clears it

fields.name: unknown 09ba
fields.meaning: Two bytes, always 0; only the save/load code touches them
fields.evidence: packer/unpacker copy them; no game-logic references anywhere in the ROM

fields.name: game started flag
fields.meaning: Set to 1 when a new game begins
fields.evidence: new-game code sets live 11C2=1; menu code copies it

fields.name: Digimon exchange area
fields.meaning: Server-terminal area: count byte, three 3-byte entries (FFFF = empty), three 105-byte Digimon records
fields.evidence: init code clears it and sets the entries to FFFF; terminal menu offers receive/return

fields.name: exchange: count
fields.meaning: Entry count, 0 in all saves
fields.evidence: init code clears it

fields.name: exchange: bytes 1-9
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 in all saves
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: exchange: 3 entries
fields.meaning: Three 3-byte entries (16-bit id + byte), FFFF = empty
fields.evidence: init code sets FFFF

fields.name: exchange: bytes 13-15
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 in all saves
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: exchange: 3 records
fields.meaning: Three 105-byte Digimon records, empty
fields.evidence: init code clears first byte of each

fields.name: exchange: tail
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 except the flag byte below
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: exchange: flag byte
fields.meaning: Bit 0x20 set when a new game starts; likely unlock/progress flags
fields.evidence: init code ORs 0x20 at live 4677

fields.name: Ryo record
fields.meaning: 139-byte record for Ryo
fields.evidence: packer copies 0x8B from live 4368; init code uses stride 0x8B

fields.name: tamer: two words
fields.meaning: Two 16-bit values, cleared at new game, 0 in saves; possibly money/points
fields.evidence: init code clears them; no readers identified

fields.name: tamer: bytes 4-7
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 in all saves
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: tamer: item bag
fields.meaning: 33 item slots of 3 bytes: item number (FFFF = empty) and count
fields.evidence: init code inits 33 slots and starting items (Ryo 1,2 / Ken 4,0D)

fields.name: tamer: party order
fields.meaning: 3 pairs (0, slot): order of the party slots
fields.evidence: init code sets them; party code swaps them when compacting

fields.name: tamer: bytes 71-72
fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 in all saves
fields.evidence: dump only

fields.name: tamer: area and maps
fields.meaning: Area, map, sub-map, zone bytes (Ryo starts 02 0E 02 03)
fields.evidence: init code sets them; event code rewrites them on warps; map byte changes on room change, sub-map entering the hub

fields.name: tamer: X
fields.meaning: Tile X position
fields.evidence: walker e000:972E and event code increment/decrement it; changes with walking

fields.name: tamer: Y
fields.meaning: Tile Y position
fields.evidence: same writers; changes with walking

fields.meaning: Unknown; 0 in all saves
fields.evidence: cleared at new game

fields.name: tamer: facing
fields.meaning: Facing: 0 north, 1 east, 2 south, 3 west
fields.evidence: walker switches on it to pick the step direction; write-watch trace

fields.name: tamer: moving
fields.meaning: 1 while stepping, 0 at rest (0 in every save)
fields.evidence: walker sets 1, event code sets 0; trace

fields.name: Ryo Digimon storage
fields.meaning: 9 Digimon records of 105 bytes, all empty; kept-monster storage
fields.evidence: packer copies 0x3B1 from live 4804; init code clears with stride 0x69

fields.name: never-filled gap
fields.meaning: 105 bytes the packer skips between the two storage blocks (stale buffer, zero)
fields.evidence: packer jumps from staging 33E2 to 344B; zero in every save

fields.name: Ken Digimon storage
fields.meaning: 9 Digimon records of 105 bytes, all empty
fields.evidence: packer copies 0x3B1 from live 4C1E

fields.name: never-filled tail
fields.meaning: Last 105 bytes of the data block the packer never fills (zero)
fields.evidence: packer ends at staging 38FC but length covers 38C5

fields.name: copy 0 end marker
fields.meaning: End marker; always 03
fields.evidence: writer writes it, checker returns 2 without it

fields.name: copy 0 checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT over length + data + end marker, high result byte first
fields.evidence: table CRC d000:04D8; recomputed over every save, both copies

fields.name: copy 0 padding
fields.meaning: Unused zero space after the copy
fields.evidence: zero in every save; never read
